name: Human
bonusLanguages: Any (other than secret languages, such as Druidic). See the Speak Language skill.
traits: One bonus feat at 1st level. Allocate it in Feats.
Four extra skill points at 1st level and one at every later level. Spend these points manually.

name: Dwarf
bonusLanguages: Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, and Undercommon.
traits: Stonecunning; dwarven weapon familiarity; stability while grounded.
Poison saves +2; saves against spells and spell-like effects +2. These conditional bonuses are entered for the relevant roll.
Attacks against orcs and goblinoids +1; dodge AC against giants +4. Stone/metal Appraise and Craft checks +2.
Armor and carried loads do not reduce the dwarf’s base land speed.

name: Elf
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
traits: Immune to magical sleep; saves against enchantments +2.
Proficient with longsword, rapier, longbow, and shortbow, including composite bows.
Search check for secret or concealed doors passed within 5 feet.

name: Gnome
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. In addition, a gnome can speak with a burrowing mammal (a badger, fox, rabbit, or the like, see below). This ability is innate to gnomes. See the speak with animals spell description.
traits: Gnome hooked hammer familiarity. Illusion saves +2; illusion spell DCs +1.
Attacks against kobolds and goblinoids +1; dodge AC against giants +4.
Speak with burrowing mammals 1/day. With Charisma 10+, dancing lights, ghost sound, and prestidigitation each 1/day; caster level 1.

name: Half-Elf
bonusLanguages: Any (other than secret languages, such as Druidic).
traits: Immune to magical sleep; enchantment saves +2.
Counts as an elf for race-related effects.

name: Half-Orc
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Giant, Gnoll, Goblin, and Abyssal.
traits: Counts as an orc for race-related effects. Starting Intelligence after the racial adjustment is at least 3.

name: Halfling
bonusLanguages: Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, and Orc.
traits: All saves +1. Against fear, add a further +2 morale bonus.
Thrown weapon and sling attacks +1. Use damage dice for Small weapons.

name: Deep Dwarf
bonusLanguages: Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, and Undercommon.
traits: Dwarf traits, except poison and spell/spell-like saves increase to +3.
Light sensitivity: dazzled in bright sunlight or a daylight spell.

name: Mountain Dwarf
bonusLanguages: Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, and Undercommon.
traits: Stonecunning; dwarven weapon familiarity; stability while grounded.
Poison saves +2; saves against spells and spell-like effects +2. These conditional bonuses are entered for the relevant roll.
Attacks against orcs and goblinoids +1; dodge AC against giants +4. Stone/metal Appraise and Craft checks +2.
Armor and carried loads do not reduce the dwarf’s base land speed.

name: Duergar
bonusLanguages: Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, Terran, and Undercommon.
traits: Dwarf stonecunning, weapon familiarity, stability, and situational combat bonuses.
Immune to paralysis, phantasms, and poison; spell and spell-like saves +2.
Enlarge person and invisibility each 1/day; caster level twice class level, minimum 3. Check source restrictions.
Light sensitivity: dazzled in bright sunlight or daylight.

name: Drow
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
traits: Elf sleep immunity, enchantment resistance, and senses. Spell resistance 11 + class levels.
Will saves against spells and spell-like abilities +2.
Dancing lights, darkness, and faerie fire each 1/day.
Hand crossbow, rapier, and short sword proficiency replace standard elf weapons.
Light blindness: blinded for the first round of abrupt bright light, then dazzled while exposed.

name: Aquatic Elf
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
traits: Elf traits with the aquatic subrace changes. Swim speed 40 ft.; aquatic breathing and swimming rules apply.
Superior low-light vision replaces ordinary low-light vision.

name: Gray Elf
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
traits: Immune to magical sleep; saves against enchantments +2.
Proficient with longsword, rapier, longbow, and shortbow, including composite bows.
Search check for secret or concealed doors passed within 5 feet.

name: Wild Elf
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
traits: Immune to magical sleep; saves against enchantments +2.
Proficient with longsword, rapier, longbow, and shortbow, including composite bows.
Search check for secret or concealed doors passed within 5 feet.

name: Wood Elf
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
traits: Immune to magical sleep; saves against enchantments +2.
Proficient with longsword, rapier, longbow, and shortbow, including composite bows.
Search check for secret or concealed doors passed within 5 feet.

name: Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. In addition, a gnome can speak with a burrowing mammal (a badger, fox, rabbit, or the like, see below). This ability is innate to gnomes. See the speak with animals spell description.
traits: All saves +2; dodge AC +4 against every opponent. Stonecunning.
Spell resistance 11 + class levels. Nondetection continuously; blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self each 1/day.
Hide racial bonus +2, increasing to +4 underground. Illusion spell DCs +1. See reference for spell-like restrictions.

name: Forest Gnome
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, and Orc. In addition, a gnome can speak with a burrowing mammal (a badger, fox, rabbit, or the like, see below). This ability is innate to gnomes. See the speak with animals spell description.
traits: Gnome traits with forest subrace changes; pass without trace at will.
Hide racial bonus +4, increasing to +8 in woodland. Attacks against orcs and reptilian humanoids also gain +1.
Communicate simple messages with forest animals. Common must be selected as a bonus language.

name: Gnoll
bonusLanguages: Common, Draconic, Elven, Goblin, Orc.
traits: Racial HD contribute BAB +1, Fort +3, Ref +0, Will +0; add these to class totals manually.
Allocate racial skill points and one racial-HD feat from the source.

name: Goblin
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Elven, Giant, Gnoll, Orc.
traits: Use Small weapon damage dice. The ordinary 1 humanoid HD is replaced by the first class level.

name: Hobgoblin
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Dwarven, Infernal, Giant, Orc.
traits: The ordinary 1 humanoid HD is replaced by the first class level.

name: Kobold
bonusLanguages: Common, Undercommon.
traits: Light sensitivity: dazzled in bright sunlight or daylight.
Core Monster Manual kobold; optional web enhancements and dragonwrought changes are not included.

name: Lizardfolk
bonusLanguages: Aquan, Goblin, Gnoll, Orc.
traits: Racial HD contribute BAB +1, Fort +0, Ref +3, Will +0; add these to class totals manually.
Two claws (1d4 each) and bite (1d4); add natural attacks in Combat.
Hold breath for 4 × Constitution score rounds. Allocate racial skill points and racial-HD feat manually.

name: Orc
bonusLanguages: Dwarven, Giant, Gnoll, Goblin, Undercommon.
traits: Light sensitivity: dazzled in bright sunlight or daylight.

name: Aasimar
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling,
traits: Acid, cold, and electricity resistance 5.
Daylight 1/day, caster level equal to class levels.

name: Tiefling
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc.
traits: Cold, electricity, and fire resistance 5.
Darkness 1/day, caster level equal to class levels.

name: Dromite
bonusLanguages: Dwarven, Gnome, Goblin, Terran.
traits: Choose cold, electricity, fire, or sonic resistance 5.
Energy ray 1/day matching the chosen energy; manifester level half HD, minimum 1. Scent and Blind-Fight.

name: Duergar (Psionic)
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Giant, Goblin, Orc, Terran.
traits: Psionic duergar variant. Dwarf stability, stonecunning, weapon familiarity, and situational bonuses.
Immune to paralysis, phantasms, and poison; light sensitivity.
Expansion and psionic invisibility each 1/day; manifester level equals Hit Dice, minimum 3.

name: Elan
bonusLanguages: Any (other than secret languages, such as Druidic). Elans’ past lives expose them to wide ranges of language.
traits: Resistance: spend 1 PP as an immediate action for +4 saves until the next action.
Resilience: as an immediate action, spend PP to prevent 2 damage per point.
Repletion: spend 1 PP to avoid needing food or drink for 24 hours. No racial darkvision.

name: Half-Giant
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Giant, Gnoll, Ignan.
traits: Powerful build: treat as one size larger when advantageous for opposed size checks and size-limited attacks; use larger weapons. Space and reach stay Medium.
Fire saves +2. Stomp 1/day, manifester level half HD, minimum 1.

name: Maenad
bonusLanguages: Aquan, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Goblin. Maenads commonly know the languages of their enemies and of their friends, as well as Draconic, the language commonly found in ancient tomes of secret knowledge.
traits: Sonic energy ray 1/day; manifester level half HD, minimum 1.
Outburst 1/day for up to 4 rounds: STR +2, INT −2, WIS −2. Enter temporary adjustments while active.

name: Xeph
bonusLanguages: Draconic, Elven, Gnoll, Goblin, Halfling, Sylvan.
traits: Saves against powers, spells, and spell-like effects +1.
Burst 3/day for 3 rounds: speed +10 ft., +20 ft. at level 5, +30 ft. at level 9.

name: Changeling
bonusLanguages: See book
traits: Sleep/charm saves +2. Speak Language is a class skill.
At-will physical disguise: full-round action, possessions unchanged, +10 Disguise when used. See book for limitations.

name: Warforged
bonusLanguages: See book
traits: Composite plating: armor +2, arcane failure 5%; enter in Combat. Does not stack with armor.
Light fortification 25%; slam 1d4.
No eating, breathing, or sleeping. Ordinary healing works at half strength; lethal damage does not heal naturally.
Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, disease, nausea, fatigue, exhaustion, sickening, and energy drain. Consult living-construct exceptions.

name: Goliath
bonusLanguages: See book
traits: Powerful build permits larger weapons and favorable size treatment for opposed checks; actual size and reach stay Medium.
Standing jumps count as running jumps; accelerated climbing avoids its usual penalty. Acclimated to high altitude.

name: Whisper Gnome
bonusLanguages: See book
traits: Hooked-hammer familiarity. Attacks against kobolds/goblinoids +1; dodge AC against giants +4.
Silence centered on self 1/day. With CHA 10+, ghost sound, mage hand, and message each 1/day; caster level 1.
